spec.studio_prompt: A modern minimalist single platform bed measuring 90 cm wide, 190 cm long, and 45 cm high without a headboard. The base is upholstered in a textured, tightly looped light grey bouclé fabric (#c2c0c4) with softly rounded corners. At the head sits a single plump white cotton pillow (#dedcdc) atop a fitted white cotton sheet (#f8f6f4). The mattress is neatly covered by a soft, matte warm grey duvet (#5a5049) featuring subtle natural folds, folded down neatly at the upper third to expose the crisp white bedding underneath.
